skills.description: Choose individual engineering and productivity Skills from Matt Pocock's upstream collection.
skills.notes: Repository-level source. The upstream Codex entry point is npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills. Resolve latest to a reviewed tool version, then use the same exact default-branch HEAD or verified local snapshot for enumeration and installation. Install only exact Skill names selected by the user for Codex and the approved scope. Include setup-matt-pocock-skills when required by the selected workflow, then run the fresh-process global conflict audit.
